Social Media & Communications Manager Job at Congenital Heart Disease Foundation of Nigeria (CHDF)




        
    

        
        CHDF Nigeria is a non-profit organization that supports children and persons with Congenital Heart Disease popularly called Hole in the Heart in Nigeria. The foundation is envisioned to be the leading charity organization in Nigeria supporting the CHD cause. Our mission “to create a paradigm shift in the current status of congenital heart disease in Nigeria through awareness campaign and advocacy; support; education and research promotion” states the 4 main areas we are focusing on to achieve our vision.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Social Media & Communications Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time
     

            
    



Job Description


	We are looking for a Social Media & Communications Manager who understands that digital communication is more than posting content.
	We need someone who can identify conversations worth joining, understand audiences, build meaningful relationships, create engaging content and translate digital attention into partnerships, fundraising, advocacy and real-world impact.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage day-to-day posting across all CHDFNigeria social media platforms.
	Develop and execute monthly content calendars with the Multimedia Team across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and X.
	Actively engage with other pages and accounts through comments, replies and collaborations.
	Identify trending topics, sounds and conversations early and connect them naturally to CHD and CHDFNigeria's work.
	Bring creative ideas and energy to social-media-led fundraising campaigns.
	Engage organisations, healthcare professionals, influencers, policymakers, potential partners, donors and communities.
	Grow following and engagement across platforms, using data to understand what is working.
	Lead the Multimedia Team and ensure communication remains aligned.
	Identify and nurture online relationships that can develop into partnerships, collaborations, donations and other opportunities.
	Develop and execute monthly content calendars across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and X.


Requirements
Our ideal candidate:


	Has a Degree in Mass Communication, Public Relations, Media Studies, Marketing or a Health-related field.
	Has successfully grown a page, brand or personal audience and can demonstrate real engagement.
	Enjoys being visible, interactive and conversational online—not simply posting content from behind the screen.
	Is proficient in Canva, Meta Business Suite and analytics platforms.
	Is familiar with AI content generation and animation tools.
	Is self-motivated, organised and capable of working independently.
	Has a passion for health, humanitarian work or non-profit communications, a strong advantage.
	Medical/health-related background is a strong advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

	Strong knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance practices.

	Dependable, disciplined, and results-oriented.

Location: Benin City, Edo
Employment Type: Full Time
Industry: HVAC / Facilities Management 

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced, technically competent, and safety-conscious professional to oversee HVAC rental and maintenance activities at customer locations in Benin.
	The successful candidate will coordinate technicians, manage customer relationships, supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities, ensure timely completion of jobs, and maintain strict compliance with health and safety standards.
	The ideal candidate should have strong HVAC knowledge, excellent team leadership and customer service skills, and the ability to coordinate field operations while maintaining accurate documentation and reporting.


Key Responsibilities
Rental & Field Service Operations:


	Oversee the day-to-day running of HVAC rental activities at designated customer locations.
	Ensure quarterly preventive maintenance is carried out on all rented AC units as scheduled.
	Coordinate and supervise technicians to ensure efficient service delivery and customer satisfaction.
	Provide management and technical support to technicians in resolving field issues.
	Meet with customers periodically to review service delivery, address concerns, and discuss operational requirements.
	Receive, review, and act on reports and feedback from technicians and customers.
	Conduct regular stock-taking and ensure proper arrangement and availability of spare parts, tools, and logistics required by technicians.
	Coordinate the daily deployment of spare parts and other resources based on operational requirements.
	Ensure invoices are promptly raised for completed jobs.
	Assist in following up on and receiving customer payments where required.
	Prepare and submit periodic operational reports to the Line Manager.
	Monitor service delivery and ensure agreed customer requirements and service standards are consistently met.


Maintenance Activities:


	Coordinate day-to-day AC maintenance and repair activities at customer locations.
	Supervise maintenance jobs involving customer-owned AC units.
	Conduct site visits to assess HVAC faults and maintenance requirements.
	Prepare and coordinate quotations for repair and maintenance jobs.
	Ensure quotations are accurately prepared and submitted to customers for approval before applicable repair works commence.
	Coordinate technicians during approved repair and maintenance activities.
	Monitor completed jobs to ensure they meet required technical and quality standards.
	Ensure invoices are raised promptly after completion of approved maintenance and repair jobs.
	Maintain accurate records of quotations, completed jobs, invoices, maintenance activities, and customer feedback.
	Follow up on outstanding quotations and approved maintenance works to ensure timely execution.


Health, Safety & Environment (HSE):


	Ensure strict compliance with company HSE policies and procedures at all customer locations.
	Conduct regular checks to identify potential workplace and field safety hazards.
	Ensure technicians use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and follow safe working practices.
	Promote a strong safety culture among technicians and other field personnel.
	Report accidents, incidents, hazards, and near misses promptly and ensure appropriate corrective actions are taken.
	Ensure maintenance and field activities are conducted in accordance with applicable health, safety, and environmental requirements.
	Maintain appropriate HSE documentation and records.


Requirements


	Possess a Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Engineering or a related technical field with 3 – 5 years of relevant experience in HVAC repair, maintenance, field service, or facilities management.
	Must possess HSE Levels 1, 2 & 3 certifications.
	Strong practical knowledge of HVAC systems, particularly air-conditioning installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs.
	Proven ability to lead, supervise, and coordinate technical teams.
	Experience managing customer accounts or service relationships is an added advantage.
	Strong knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance practices.
	Ability to prepare or coordinate quotations, invoices, service reports, and maintenance documentation.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic reporting tools.
	Must be willing to work in the field and travel to customer locations as required.


Key Competencies:


	HVAC Maintenance & Repairs
	Field Service Management
	Preventive & Corrective Maintenance
	Team Leadership & Supervision
	Customer Relationship Management
	HSE Compliance
	Technical Troubleshooting
	Inventory & Spare Parts Management
	Quotation & Invoice Management
	Site Inspection
	Reporting & Documentation
	Problem Solving
	Operational Coordination


Personal Qualities:
The ideal candidate should possess:


	Strong leadership and team management abilities.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong customer service orientation.
	High level of accountability and professionalism.
	Good organizational and time-management skills.
	Strong attention to detail.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple field activities.
	Proactive and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges.
	High commitment to safety and compliance.
	Ability to work independently while maintaining effective communication with management and customers.
	Dependable, disciplined, and results-oriented.


Salary
N250,000- N300,000 monthly.

Method of Aplication 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to [email protected] using “Field Service / HSE Officer – Benin” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

        Murphy Ben International is a fast-growing IT, media, and entertainment company specializing in the distribution of African content across digital platforms. We are passionate about storytelling, talent development, and building innovative systems that empower both creators and internal teams to thrive.

	Monitor YouTube Analytics and use data to improve performance.
	Optimize content for better visibility and audience retention.

	Ensure compliance with YouTube policies and guidelines.

	Results-driven, proactive and business-minded.
	Passion for YouTube, entertainment and digital media.
